page.overview:
Who is Major Storm?

Major Storm is a battle-hardened warrior who has gone and commanded just about every tank in the Army's arsenal. He does not rely on tactics as much, instead going for gut instincts and experience. Every tank he has ever driven and commanded, he feels some kind of proprietary feeling, a parental sense if you will. The General mobile headquarters is no exception. As big a machine the General is, to him it is just another tank.
